about:
# Better Volume
some small tweaks to volume
- volume input
- swap sliders
- mute button
- change color of sliders
- custom text
and more !

## Special Thanks
- ***lyyako*** for mostly taking over dev of this mod :3

## Credits
- ***ION41091*** for lmk abt mute button texture alternative
- ***Eclipse Menu Team*** for allow value even tho i rewrote it l8r :3c

## v2.1.1
**Fixed**

- rewrote allow low volume w/ my own impl that also fixes a bug

**Removed**

- v2.1.0 colon handling because i wanted a way to remove them for my own ui :3

**Internal**

- cleaned up the code cuz 1 file was getting kinda messy
- use my api a bit more heavily

## v2.1.0
**Added** 

- option to swap Music and SFX sliders
- function to disable RobTop's 'feature' that snaps volume to 0 below 3% (thanks to ***Eclipse Menu Team***)
- new mute button texture for SFX (shoutout to ***ION41091***)

**Fixed** 

- how the colon `:` is handled so it's now properly part of the UI
- mute button positions to be visually consistent
- input precision now correctly shows 0 decimal places instead of 6 
- a bunch of other small things

## v2.0.1
**Added**

- back input precision
- better mute button sprites

## v2.0.0
**Added**

- 2.208 support
- this whole thing to the main menu options layer too (apparently people change volume outside of levels, who knew)
- incompatibility w/ alphas menu mod
- node ids
- volume muting

**Fixed** 

- broken ui in platformer mode
- node ids
